location.selector: q12 key feedback and option B feedback

findings.claim: 'A value written with ENV lives in the image, so changing it needs a rebuild' is imprecise. docker run -e or --env-file overrides an ENV default without a rebuild; only changing the baked-in default needs one. The key stays uniquely best because two images for two environments is the anti-pattern, but the feedback can read as 'ENV cannot be overridden'.
findings.recommendation: Reword to 'A value written with ENV is baked into the image as its default; building two images per environment is unnecessary because -e overrides it at run time.'

findings.claim: The stem says neither the shell nor .env sets POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_DB. Compose then substitutes empty strings (with a warning), so the key 'Compose, from your machine' is right about who expands the text but the learner may wonder what it expands to. The taught point ($$ for container-side expansion) is decided correctly and D (reaches pg_isready as written) is wrong.
findings.recommendation: Optional: say 'Compose substitutes an empty value, with a warning' in the key feedback.

findings.claim: Fact check only: the key is correct against the GitHub docs (GITHUB_TOKEN with packages: write can publish packages linked to the repository to ghcr.io; it holds no credentials for another registry). The defect is taught scope (CFE-1), not accuracy.
findings.recommendation: No SME change; resolve through CFE-1.
